parameters.name: JobType
parameters.description: Task Type. Currently, only DOWNLOWD_MARKRESULT_FLOW is available.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The quantity of annotation results displayed per page in a paged query. The default value is 20.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page number of the annotation result list. The starting value is 1, and the default value is 1.

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.description: Tenant ID. For information about how to obtain a tenant ID, see [ListTenants](~~454649~~).
